# Wayne Barlowe

> > Official portfolio of Wayne Barlowe, Hugo Award-winning sci-fi/fantasy artist and author known for creature design, worldbuilding, and concept art for Avatar, Pacific Rim, and Hellboy.

Wayne Barlowe is a renowned illustrator specializing in speculative biology, infernal imagery, and paleoart. His signature works include Expedition (Darwin IV alien ecosystem), God's Demon and Barlowe's Inferno (Hell series), concept art for major films, and influential guides to extraterrestrial and fantasy creatures.

## Key Topics

- Wayne Barlowe
- Expedition / Darwin IV
- God's Demon / Barlowe's Inferno
- Hell artwork

- Speculative biology
- Concept art (Avatar, Pacific Rim, Hellboy)
- Paleoart / dinosaur illustration
- Barlowe's Guide to Extraterrestrials
- Barlowe's Guide to Fantasy

- Film/TV/game design
- Discovery Channel's Alien Planet
- Hugo Award winner

## Portfolio & Artwork

- [Artwork | waynebarlowe](https://waynebarlowe.com/artwork): Main portfolio hub featuring Hell, Expedition, Film/TV/Game, and Paleoart
- [Hell | waynebarlowe](https://waynebarlowe.com/artwork/hell): Infernal paintings from God's Demon and Barlowe's Inferno series
- [Expedition | waynebarlowe](https://waynebarlowe.com/artwork/expedition): Darwin IV alien creatures portfolio from the 2358 A.D. voyage project
- [Film, TV & Game | waynebarlowe](https://waynebarlowe.com/artwork/film-tv-game): Concept art for Avatar, Pacific Rim, Harry Potter, and game projects
- [Paleoart & Illustration | waynebarlowe](https://waynebarlowe.com/artwork/paleoart_illustration): Dinosaur illustrations and book covers including Horned Dinosaurs
- [Other Projects | waynebarlowe](https://waynebarlowe.com/artwork/other-projects): Powerlords toys, Barlowe's Guide to Extraterrestrials, and misc work
